title: Symrise opens new Scent Creative Center in Singapore to accelerate growth in Asia
summary: – Consumer-centric hub brings customers, perfumers and experts together for faster co-creation – Global Skin Cleansing Center of Excellence strengthens category expertise and elevate sharing of best practices – Creative Center advances ONE Symrise ecosystem and long-term commitment to Singapore & Asia

title: From foresight to flavor: Symrise advances Symvision AI™ into an end-to-end innovation platform
summary: – Expands Symvision AI™ from foresight into a four-pillar end-to-end platform – Combines proprietary sensory and consumer intelligence with Symrise expertise and AI – Creates the foundation for a broader ONE Symrise cross-divisional approach over time

title: Symrise opens the doors to Grand Hôtel Particulier at Beautyworld Dubai
summary: – ONE Symrise experience connects Fine Fragrance, Consumer Products and Cosmetic Ingredients – Grand Hôtel Particulier brings golden-age luxury to life in six immersive sensory worlds – Distinct fragrances combined with state-of-the-art technologies and efficacious cosmetic ingredients to inspire premium creations for the dynamic Middle East market

title: Symrise strengthens natural fragrance ecosystem with new Lautier 1795 site in Grasse
summary: – Strategic investment expands Symrise capabilities for premium natural fragrance ingredients – Connects sourcing, transformation, innovation and production in the heart of the Grasse ecosystem – Advances ONE Symrise by linking specialist local expertise with the Group’s global fragrance capabilities

title: Symrise completes acquisition of Floral Concept, strengthening its position in Premium Naturals
summary: – Completion reinforces Symrise’s Premium Naturals position in fragrance – Floral Concept joins Maison Lautier 1795 in a Naturals cluster in Grasse – Combined expertise spans sourcing, transformation and fragrance creation – Acquisition supports ONE Symrise and active portfolio development

title: Ausbildungsstart 2026: Symrise, Tesium und Symotion begrüßen 50 neue Auszubildende und dual Studierende
summary: – Junge Talente starten in Holzminden in technischen, chemischen, kaufmännischen, logistischen und gastronomischen Berufen – Erstmals sechstägiges Onboarding-Programm für Orientierung, Teamgeist und Praxiseinblicke – Nahezu vollständige Übernahmequote in Gesamtbetriebsvereinbarung verankert

title: Symrise signs agreement to divest its Terpene Ingredients business to Mutares SE & Co. KGaA
summary: — Positions AmeriTerpenes LLC for long-term growth under Mutares' ownership — Advances the ONE Symrise strategy through continued portfolio management — Secures long-term supply, customer service, and commercial partnership between Symrise and AmeriTerpenes

title: Symrise expands natural-origin skincare portfolio with Dragosine® green for skin longevity
summary: — 100% plant-derived L-carnosine for natural-origin skincare concepts — Supports skin longevity, prejuvenation, and visible skin improvement — Strengthens Symrise’s Care & Wellness portfolio with Dragosine® efficacy heritage and green biotechnology

title: Symrise reports solid H1 2026 performance with accelerating growth momentum in Q2
summary: – Organic sales growth accelerated to 4.5% in Q2 2026 (2.0% in H1 2026) – Adjusted EBITDA of €553 million and 21.8% adjusted EBITDA margin – Adjusted Business Free Cash Flow margin up 450 bps to 13.7% of sales – Planned acquisition of Floral Concept will strengthen position in Premium Naturals – Full year 2026 outlook reaffirmed

title: Symrise signs a put option agreement to acquire Floral Concept
summary: - Contemplated acquisition accelerates Symrise towards a leading position in Premium Naturals and enhances its offering for Fragrance customers - Creates a distinctive, best-in-class Naturals cluster in Pays de Grasse by bringing together Floral Concept and Maison Lautier within its Fragrance division - Supports Symrise’s ONE Symrise strategy to drive for profitable growth, margin resilience and strong cash generation via active portfolio management

title: Symrise secures patent protection for SymSave® H technology in China
summary: — Strengthens protected multifunctional innovation in Symrise’s Care & Wellness portfolio — Granted by the China National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA) — Covers Hydroxyacetophenone–lipophilic compositions in aqueous formulations — Part of an international patent family spanning the US, Korea, Japan, Brazil, and India

title: Symrise wins worldwide L’Oréal Energy Award for circular hydrogen recycling that advances decarbonization in cosmetics
summary: – L'Oréal honors "Closing the Hydrogen Loop" as a pioneering circular production model – Reduces fresh hydrogen demand by around 80% and improves process efficiency at scale – Supports reliable supply and lower carbon intensity for everyday cosmetic applications

title: Symrise receives CDP’s top “A” rating for sustainable supplier engagement and Scope 3 transparency
summary: – CDP recognizes supplier collaboration, climate action, and transparent data along the value chain – Responsible sourcing supports customers in reaching Scope 3 targets and strengthens sustainable supply chains

title: Symrise launches SYM ALPHA™ Think Tank
summary: ‒ Validates concepts early with Generation Alpha insights ‒ Combines sensory workshops, cultural intelligence, and AI validation ‒ Turns consumer signals into faster, confident go-to-market decisions

title: Symrise breaks ground on the second phase of construction for its logistics center in Holzminden
summary: – Investment of approximately 25 million euros in the second phase of the project – Expansion of capacity and efficiency to strengthen global delivery capabilities – A symbol of growth, investment in the company headquarters, and a commitment to operational excellence

title: Symrise opens Northwest Arkansas Food Studio: expanding customer collaboration & culinary innovation in North America
summary: — Culinary-forward space designed to accelerate innovation and deepen customer collaboration in North America — To enhance speed and partnership development via hands-on co-creation and rapid prototyping — A kitchen-first, hospitality-driven environment, offering immersive tasting, live demos, and real-time concept development beyond traditional lab settings

title: When smoke evolves: Symrise ensures authentic flavor experiences for a changing market
summary: – EU-compliant smoke taste solutions for consistent consumer-preferred flavor profiles – Reliable reformulation support backed by end-to-end supply chain expertise – Future-ready smoke flavorings that go beyond today’s compliance requirements

title: Annual General Meeting confirms dividend of €1.25 and approves all proposed resolutions
summary: – CEO Dr Jean-Yves Parisot reports on solid growth and increased profitability in the 2025 financial year and progress in transformation – Dividend of €1.25 per share approved – Welcome to three new Supervisory Board members

title: Building Bridges: Symrise strengthens Food & Beverage capabilities in Barcelona and shortens distances
summary: ‒ Expanded production capacity and modernized application and quality labs ‒ Faster scale-up, flexible powder formats, and close technical support ‒ Local partner services for Southern Europe and adjacent markets

title: Symrise reports solid Q1 2026 sales results and reaffirms 2026 outlook
summary: ‒ Organic sales decline of 0.4% year-on-year, stronger than anticipated, with solid performance in Food & Beverage, Pet Food and Fragrance ‒ ONE SYM Transformation Program accelerating significant structural cost savings and efficiency gains to unlock organic growth opportunities through strategic reinvestment ‒ Full year 2026 outlook reaffirmed

title: Symrise presents Health Active & Probi® portfolios at Vitafoods Europe to deliver science‑backed wellness solutions
summary: ‒ Symrise is jointly exhibiting Health Active and Probi solutions for the first time following the launch of the Care & Wellness Division ‒ Product launches for sports and active nutrition, vascular health, and postbiotic solutions highlight scientific and innovation excellence ‒ Premier of the preconcept taste bar showcasing innovative applications to experience at the show ‒ First Exclusive Innovation Lunch to be hosted on May 5

title: Symrise invests in Bond Pet Foods to accelerate sustainable innovation in pet nutrition via precision fermentation
summary: ‒ Expands Symrise’s pet nutrition offering to meet rising demand for sustainable, responsible solutions ‒ Co-develops a new ingredient to support the shift toward sustainable options, including animal-identical protein, to diversify existing pet food portfolio ‒ Invests in Bond Pet Foods’ proprietary precision-fermentation platform to speed up commercialization of next-generation pet nutrition solutions

title: Symrise accelerates innovation and champions longevity and inner beauty at in-cosmetics global 2026
summary: ‒ Participation as a founding exhibitor in the Inner Beauty Zone presenting its Care & Wellness Division ‒ Launch of three cosmetic ingredients: Cellexora® MD, Mindera® Euca, and SymConcentrole® Barrier Boost ‒ Presentation of ‘Good Planets Are Hard to Find’ campaign, highlighting longevity and sustainability ‒ Experts to lead R&D Tours, Formulation Lab sessions, a technical seminar and more

title: Symrise celebrates third World Vanilla Day with global activities
summary: ‒ Symrise brings the taste, scent, origin and diversity of vanilla to life worldwide ‒ From Holzminden to Madagascar: Symrise highlights responsibility and partnership along the value chain ‒ As a vanilla pioneer and strategic partner, Symrise is helping shape the future of vanilla

title: Symrise launches Mindera® Euca bringing plant-based product protection to rinse-off formulations
summary: ‒ Gives formulators 100% plant-based, enhanced product protection with a rich sensorial signature ‒ Helps brands answer clean beauty and wellness trends in rinse-off personal care, delivering strong performance and safety ‒ Builds on Symrise’s patented Mindera® platform, which now supports product protection across all personal care categories ‒ This new cosmetic ingredient joins the portfolio of Symrise's holistic Care & Wellness Division

title: Symrise launches Cellexora™ MD, a pioneering healthspan ingredient for premium skincare
summary: ‒ Next‑generation plant‑derived true exosomes supporting long‑term skin regeneration, resilience, and vitality ‒ 100% natural origin ingredient combining scientific rigor with exceptional stability and reproducibility ‒ Responsibly upcycled from organic Italian apple side streams via a clean, traceable and sustainable process ‒ This new cosmetic ingredient joins the portfolio of Symrise's holistic care platform Care & Wellness

title: Symrise establishes a new Care & Wellness Division
summary: ‒ Segment Scent & Care addresses consumer shift towards topical and ingestible solutions for everyday health, wellbeing, and beauty, always looking for a healthier longevity ‒ Integrated expertise in cosmetic ingredients, health actives, and biotics for science-backed solutions ‒ Accelerates ingredient innovation, collaboration and sustainable growth through scientific excellence

title: Symrise delivered solid organic sales growth and strong profitability improvement for 2025
summary: — Organic sales growth of 2.8%; Group sales of €4,929 million — Adjusted EBITDA margin of 21.9%, up 120 bps YoY — Record adjusted Business Free Cash Flow (BFCF) of €780 million, or 15.8% BFCF margin, up 220 bps YoY — Updated capital allocation priorities: announced inaugural €400 million share buyback and proposed 16th consecutive dividend increase to €1.25 per share for 2025 — Introducing 2026 Outlook: organic growth of 2.0-4.0%, adjusted EBITDA margin of 21.5-22.5%, and BFCF margin of above 14%

title: Gen alpha explained: tasting tomorrow’s trends today
summary: – Opens market opportunities and early brand loyalty for partners – Reveals unique eating and drinking behaviors of generation alpha – Positions Symrise as a pioneer in understanding future consumer needs

title: Bachelor-Abschluss und Zukunft im Blick: Vier dual BA-Studierende von Symrise erzielen Bestnoten
summary: – Feierliche Zeugnisverleihung an die Absolventen im Alten Rathaus Göttingen – Notendurchschnitt von 1,55 für "Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration" – Ausbildung und Förderung künftiger Fachkräfte strategisch verankert

title: American Authorities closing ongoing Antitrust Investigation against Symrise
CDP recognizes Symrise for sustainability results

title: Symrise AG Announces Inaugural Share Buy-back Program
summary: — Supervisory Board authorizes repurchase of shares up to EUR 400 million — The program will be active between 1 February and 31 October, 2026

title: Science meets wellbeing — Chondractiv™ Move by Symrise shows clinical results for joint health in active women aged 40+
summary: – Four-in-one solution from hydrolyzed chicken cartilage and rosehip – Backed by market insights, clinical evidence and significant results – Targeted for perimenopausal and menopausal women with an active lifestyle

title: Symrise launches digital platform on CO₂ tracking and reinforces its bioeconomy commitment at COP30
summary: – Contributing to COP30 focusing on biodiversity and circularity – Advancing data-driven climate action with partners by launching ‘Houston’ a greenhouse gas emissions tracking platform – Entering the global bioeconomy dialogue with a co-chair function

title: Prediction meets taste: Symrise expands Symvision AI™ to proprietary taste development tools
summary: ‒ Enables accelerated innovation with prediction of formulations for taste solutions ‒ Distinct toolset to leverage flavorist expertise and AI to accelerate targeted flavor design ‒ Data-driven prediction of sensory characteristics in prospective product formulations

title: COP30: Honduras and Suriname partner with Deutsche Bank, Symrise and other industry players to mobilize financial support for rainforest protection
A bite into the future! Symrise at Gulfood Manufacturing 2025
summary: ‒ Showcases accelerated innovation with Symvision AI, consumer insights and local validation ‒ Reveals new Gen Alpha study brought to life with an immersive visitor experience at the booth ‒ Proves food and beverage thought leadership via industry dialogue in expert panels

title: Symrise Reports Third Quarter 2025 Sales
summary: — Organic growth of 1.4% in Q3; organic growth of 2.6% in first nine months of 2025 — Acceleration of transformation — Successful placement of €800 million bond, issued with a term of 7 years and coupon rate of 3.25% — Updating guidance to reflect the current global demand environment: • Moderating 2025 organic growth to 2.3%-3.3% from 3.0%-5.0% • Reaffirming of EBITDA margin of ~21.5% and Business Free Cash Flow of ~14%

title: Symrise wins BSB Innovation Award® Environment for its best-in-class pentylene glycol Hydrolite® 5 green
summary: ‒ 2025 Award recognizes sustainable solution upcycled from certified sources ‒ High-quality ingredient now produced in Spain and the USA, strengthening supply chains
